title: heartbeat
description: Sent every 5 seconds on the command channel. The FIRST message of every connection must be a heartbeat with `dna_payload`: the server reads it before it registers the connection (hardware reconciliation, enrollment, device row, `server_info`). A heartbeat is the one agent message without a `type`: the server recognises it by `status` (any message whose `type` is not one of the listed types and that has `status` is a heartbeat). An agent may send `"type": "heartbeat"`; every server release ignores it. Heartbeats are written to the database in batches every 2 seconds (Backend/pops/heartbeats.py).

type.description: Optional. The Windows agent omits it.

status.description: Always "Online". Stored in `clients.status` as sent; its presence is what makes the message a heartbeat.

hostname.description: Computer name, shown in the panel. Defaults to the device ID when missing.

active_window.description: Process name of the foreground application, or "-". Never a window title (privacy). Defaults to "-".

quarantined.description: 0.1.5+. True while the lock screen and/or network isolation is active. Read only on a connection authenticated with the device secret: the server completes or re-sends (at most every 5 minutes) a pending `lockdown`/`unlock`, or mirrors the agent's state when nothing is pending.

agent_health.description: 0.1.12+. Health summary, stored per device (Backend/pops/agent_health.py keeps only these keys and drops values of the wrong type). `started_at` also decides what happens to tasks still `Running` when the agent reconnects.

started_at.description: Unix time (s) the agent process started.

last_policy_sync.description: Unix time (s) of the last successful policy fetch.

last_inventory_upload.description: Unix time (s) of the last hardware inventory upload.

vision_channel.description: off = Vision capability disabled; idle = enabled, no stream; connected = the Vision channel is open.

loop_errors_1h.description: Background-loop errors in the last hour (server caps at 100000).

last_error.description: Sanitized last error; the server keeps 200 characters.

network_isolated.description: 0.1.13+. Quarantine network isolation applied. `quarantined: true` with `network_isolated: false` makes the server warn once and resend `lockdown`.

isolation_error.description: 0.1.13+. Why isolation could not be applied (200 characters kept).

dna_payload.description: Hardware fingerprint. Required on the first message of a connection (without it an enrollment-token connection is closed with 4401); the Windows agent sends it on every heartbeat and the server ignores it after the first. Without the device secret the server may answer `set_identity`.

hardware.description: Normalized identifiers; "NULL", empty, all-zero or vendor placeholder values count as unknown and score nothing (Backend/pops/dna.py).

bios_sn.description: BIOS serial number (Linux agent: SMBIOS system serial, else the board serial).

disk_sn.description: System disk serial (the Windows agent falls back to the volume ID, the Linux agent to the root file system's UUID).

capabilities.description: What could be read; only `ram_readable` is used by the server.

ram_readable.description: False: RAM serials could not be read and are not compared.

disk_serial_real.description: False: `disk_sn` is a volume ID. Not used by the server.

dmi_readable.description: Linux agent: False when the DMI files (root only) could not be read. Not used by the server.

os.description: Operating system name. Not used by the server.

hw_id.description: Sent by the Windows agent; ignored (the URL path is the identity).

lab_name.description: Sent by the Windows agent ("Atanmamis_Cihazlar"); ignored.

platform.description: Linux agent: operating system family, the same value as its `X-Agent-Platform` header (the server prefers the header). Stored in `clients.platform` from the first message. The Windows agent does not send it (= windows).

system.description: Linux agent: current load of the PC. Not stored by the server yet.

cpu_pct.description: CPU use since the previous heartbeat, percent.

disk_root_pct.description: Root file system in use, percent.
